# assignmentB2KeryanneGagnon

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of assignmentB2KeryanneGagnon is to allow users to count the missing values in a data frame for all columns, except one which is used to group the variables (and missing values).

## Installation

Package installation can be done directly by calling:

``` r
devtools::install_github("UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2KeryanneGagnon")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to use the `count_all_missing_by_group` function from the `assignmentB2KeryanneGagnon` package:

```{r example}
library(assignmentB2KeryanneGagnon)
count_all_missing_by_group(airquality, Month)
count_all_missing_by_group(airquality, Month, .groups = "keep")
```

What is special about using `README.Rmd` instead of just `README.md`? You can include R chunks like so:

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
```

You'll still need to render `README.Rmd` regularly, to keep `README.md` up-to-date. `devtools::build_readme()` is handy for this.

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo = FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

In that case, don't forget to commit and push the resulting figure files, so they display on GitHub and CRAN.
